text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Here we are at a G2 race, the Yayoi Sho. The lineup of racers looks quite impressive.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Although, I do feel like something is lacking… on the data collection front.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing Agnes Tachyon's words, I can't help but worry a little.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Why of course. The results of this race will have an impact on the Satsuki Sho. It would be suboptimal to limit my possibilities, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Even if it isn't G1 level, I can't exactly waltz in on this race, can I?
